questions.question: Twinning in crystals can cause which of the following effects on the SADP in TEM?

answers.a: Twinning does not affect the SADP.
answers.b: Twinning can result in double diffraction spots.
answers.d: Twinning causes the diffraction spots to shift in position.

questions.question: How does the presence of amorphous regions in a crystalline material affect the SADP observed in TEM?

answers.a: It causes the diffraction spots to become sharper.
answers.b: It leads to the appearance of a halo or diffuse ring.
answers.c: It enhances the intensity of the diffraction spots.
answers.d: It does not affect the SADP at all.

questions.question: Cold rolling reduces grain size due to which mechanism?
In a heavily cold-rolled FCC metal like copper, what happens to the diffraction spots in the SADP?

answers.a: They become broader and more diffuse due to increased defect density

questions.question: . Which factor influences the extent of defect formation in cold-rolled metals?
What is a common effect of severe cold rolling on the electrical conductivity of copper?

answers.a: Increases due to reduced impurity content
answers.b: Decreases due to increased defect density and electron scattering
answers.d: Increases due to twin boundary formation
